## Description

A planktonic desmid with 3 or 4 radii. Seen from a pole (apical view) it is a three-armed star; it
measures 34–96 µm long and 48–125 µm wide with the arms, which carry rows of spiny granules and whose
length varies greatly with the environment. The arms slow its sinking.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

In apical view: a ~26 µm body and three arms of ~34 µm at 120° (~95 µm tip to tip) as
[body processes](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md); the rigid cellulose wall keeps the arms from bending. The arms
make it too wide for the mouth of *Frontonia*.
